_comment: TEMPLATE ONLY - not real data. Copy this file's SHAPE into your own agl_tariff_rates.json, which lives in the AGL data home (agl_common.resolve_agl_data_home() - a sibling of the Tessie/ data folder, NEVER inside this repo's Tools/ directory - see AGENTS.md REQ-034). Every real figure is specific to one account's plan and billing history and is treated as PII here, so no real rates are checked in. 'periods' is sorted by 'effective_from' (YYYY-MM-DD) - each period's rates apply from that date up to (not including) the next period's 'effective_from'. Rates are ex GST; agl_cost_calculator.py applies a final 10% GST multiplier to the whole bill, matching how AGL's own invoices total it. Get your own real rates from your account's AGL invoices (read the FULL invoice text, not just the plan summary - see REQ-031's own hard-won lesson about a missed 'Next*' solar-tier line).

periods.note: Example placeholder period - replace with your own plan's rates and the date they took effect.
